description: Decodes a JWT you supply (header and payload, base64url JSON) and reports its algorithm, key id, claims, and time checks (exp, nbf, iat). Flags alg none, symmetric HS algorithms, missing exp and a jku/x5u key reference. It does not verify the signature, because no key is given, and it does not fetch the key URL. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

token.description: A JWT in compact form: header.payload.signature (required, max 8 KB)
